header: What a station is made of
lead: The same specification has been fitted to every mast since the 2024 refit. Anything on this list can be replaced from the van without a laptop.

entries.title: Sampling interval
entries.text: Fixed. Shorter intervals fill the local store before a winter service round can reach the mast.

entries.title: Level sensor
entries.text: Pressure probe against a fixed reference plate, re-surveyed every spring.

entries.title: Temperature
entries.text: 30 cm below the surface and 20 cm above the bed, so stratification shows up as a difference rather than a guess.

entries.title: Local storage
entries.text: Enough to bridge an outage until the next scheduled visit.

entries.title: Power
entries.text: Sized for willow shade in January, not for June.

entries.title: Transmission
entries.text: Four readings per message. A failed send is retried on the next hour rather than immediately.
